step1_analysis.description: A passive switched-capacitor circuit that samples the input voltage onto multiple capacitors during one clock phase and redistributes the charge onto an output capacitor during the second phase, effectively acting as a capacitive voltage multiplier or DAC.

paper_reference.title: A Fourth-Order Interface for Micromachined Inertial Sensors

voltage_gain.description: Ratio of output voltage to input voltage during the transfer phase

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = -(C1+C2A+C2B)/(C1+C2A+C2B+CP). Assuming equal capacitors, Gain = -0.75 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by capacitor ratios. The 20 dB gain in the paper likely refers to an active amplifier stage following this passive network.

dynamic_power.description: Power consumed by charging and discharging the capacitors

sky130_expected.reasoning: The 13 mW reported in the paper is for the entire ADC interface. The passive SC network alone consumes much less power, dominated by dynamic switching power.

settling_time.description: Time required for the output voltage to settle during the transfer phase

sky130_expected.calculation: tau = Ron * C_tot = 100 ohm * 4 pF = 0.4 ns. Settling time (99%) = 4.6 * tau = ~1.8 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the ON-resistance of the switches and the total capacitance.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure voltage gain, settling behavior, and dynamic power of the switched-capacitor network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switched Capacitor Circuit Testbench
.param Cval=1p
.model switch_ideal sw vt=0.9 vh=0.1 ron=100 roff=1G

* DUT (Corrected for ngspice switch syntax: added control nodes phi1/phi2 and removed parentheses)
S1 N0 GND phi2 GND switch_ideal
S2 N6 GND phi2 GND switch_ideal
S3 VOUT N5 phi2 GND switch_ideal
S4 VOUT GND phi1 GND switch_ideal
CP VOUT GND {Cval}
C2A N2 N5 {Cval}
S5 N2 GND phi2 GND switch_ideal
S6 N1 GND phi1 GND switch_ideal
S7 N5 GND phi1 GND switch_ideal
S8 N1 VOUT phi2 GND switch_ideal
C1 VOUT N6 {Cval}
S9 N0 VIN phi1 GND switch_ideal
C2B N0 N1 {Cval}
S10 VIN N6 phi1 GND switch_ideal
S11 N2 VIN phi1 GND switch_ideal

* Sources
VVIN VIN GND DC 0.9
Vphi1 phi1 GND PULSE(0 1.8 0 1n 1n 50n 125n)
Vphi2 phi2 GND PULSE(0 1.8 62.5n 1n 1n 50n 125n)

* Analysis
.control
tran 1n 500n

* Measure gain during the second transfer phase (phi2 is high)
meas tran vout_settled find v(VOUT) at=225n
meas tran vin_val find v(VIN) at=225n
let gain = vout_settled / vin_val
print gain

* Measure dynamic power from the input source
meas tran pwr_vin integ i(VVIN) from=0 to=500n
let avg_pwr = -pwr_vin * 0.9 / 500n
print avg_pwr

quit
.endc
.end
